title: Aegis OS: A Transactional Multi-Tenant Operating System Runtime for Eliminating Authorization Fatigue in Autonomous Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.08516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous coding agents such as Google Antigravity (agy), Anthropic Claude Code (claude), and OpenAI Codex CLI (codex) execute multi-step software engineering workflows on workstations and cloud hosts. Existing agent environments face a Security-Autonomy Dilemma: operators must choose between per-action confirmation prompts, which interrupt workflows on 45%-57% of tool calls and induce authorization fatigue, or unconfined execution (--yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions), which exposes host files, SSH/cloud credentials, and API tokens to prompt injection and hallucination risks. Furthermore, concurrent agents editing a shared working tree clobber one another's changes, while passing large artifacts inline through LLM context windows incurs high token overhead.   We present Aegis OS (aegis-os), a transactional, multi-tenant Agent Operating System Runtime in Rust exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Google Agent2Agent (A2A

translated_title: Aegis OS：一个用于消除自主编码智能体授权疲劳的事务性多租户操作系统运行时
translated_abstract: 诸如 Google Antigravity (agy)、Anthropic Claude Code (claude) 和 OpenAI Codex CLI (codex) 等自主编码智能体在工作站和云端主机上执行多步骤软件工程工作流。现有的智能体环境面临“安全-自主困境”：操作者必须在逐操作确认提示（会在45%-57%的工具调用中中断工作流，并引发授权疲劳）与不受限制的执行模式（--yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions，会将主机文件、SSH/云端凭证和 API 令牌暴露于提示注入和幻觉风险之下）之间做出选择。此外，多个并发智能体在编辑共享工作树时会相互覆盖彼此的更改，而通过 LLM 上下文窗口内联传递大型工件则会带来高昂的令牌开销。我们提出了 Aegis OS (aegis-os)，一个用 Rust 编写的事务性、多租户智能体操作系统运行时，通过模型上下文协议和 Google Agent2Agent (A2A) 协议暴露……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于 Rust 实现的事务性多租户智能体操作系统运行时 Aegis OS，通过 MCP 和 A2A 协议暴露，旨在消除自主编码智能体中的授权疲劳，解决安全-自主困境、并发编辑冲突以及上下文令牌开销过高的问题。
